d: Midana Exploration Company (MEC) is a resource exploration and development company and a subsidiary of Australia’s leading private mining enterprise, Hancock Prospecting. Operating at the forefront of the Middle East’s rapidly expanding mining sector, MEC is dedicated to unlocking the vast mineral potential of the highly prospective Arabian-Nubian Shield.

Our core focus is to rapidly and safely transition high-potential exploration targets into world-class operational mining assets. We achieve this by combining Hancock Prospecting’s demonstrated track record in exploration, mega-project delivery, technology, and operational excellence with deep local partnerships. Through our landmark joint ventures with highly regarded Saudi resource companies, and our own targeted exploration prospects, we are developing a new benchmark for resource development while also actively contributing to the development of the resource sector in Saudi.
q: At least of 5 years of accounting experience as a General Accountant or similar role
Strong experience in general accounting, AP, AR, bank reconciliations, financial closing, reporting, and audit support
Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Zakat and tax compliance, including VAT, WHT, Corporate Income Tax, ZATCA, and e-invoicing
Experience with ERP systems and high-volume financial transactions
Experience in an international group, mining, exploration, or project-based environment is an advantage
Mandatory Bachelor degree in Accounting or Finance from a recognized university
Mandatory active membership with the Saudi Organization for Chartered & Professional Accountants (SOCPA)
A professional qualification/part qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred
Extensive experience, relevant training or certification in Zakat, tax, IFRS, or accounting is preferred
Strong knowledge of accounting, financial statements, internal controls, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia
Strong knowledge of Saudi Zakat and tax requirements, ZATCA rules, e-invoicing, transfer pricing, and relevant international tax principles
Strong Excel and ERP skills; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is preferred
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and ability to identify and resolve accounting or tax differences
Good organization, time management, and ability to meet closing and statutory filing deadlines
Good written and spoken English and Arabic
Professional integrity, confidentiality, teamwork, and clear communication.
The role is primarily based in MEC’s office in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
Travel to project sites and other locations through KSA may be required from time to time.
r: The General Accountant is responsible for executing day-to-day accounting operations and ensuring accurate and complete financial records for MEC and its related KSA entities. The role covers general ledger accounting, payables and receivables, banking, fixed assets, financial closing and reporting, and supports budgeting, audit, and compliance with applicable Saudi and international accounting, Zakat, tax, and regulatory requirements. Working in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller, the General Accountant provides timely and reliable financial information to support management decision-making and maintain effective financial operations and controls.

CFO; Finance team; Subsidiary Finance; department heads; MEC procurement team; Exploration Joint Venture finance teams; banks; customers; suppliers; auditors; tax advisors; and government authorities, including ZATCA, and other STH

Execute all day-to-day accounting activities and take ownership of the accurate and timely entry and maintenance of financial data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and any other accounting, banking, or tax platforms used by the Company

Maintain the General Ledger, journal entries, trial balance, accruals, provisions, prepayments, reconciliations, and foreign currency adjustments, coordinating with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller on significant or non-routine accounting matters

Complete bank reconciliations and monitor cash balances, employee advances, petty cash, corporate cards, and employee expenses, reporting material differences or outstanding items to the Finance Manager/Financial Controller
Manage sales invoicing, revenue recognition, periodical management sales reporting and reconciliations, and ZATCA VAT and e-invoicing compliance

Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support the preparation of financial statements, management reports, and reporting packages for MEC, its Board, and HPPL in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller

Maintain accounting records for fixed assets and inventory and monitor exploration, project, license, capital, and operating costs by project and cost centre in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller and relevant departments
Review and report on Exploration Joint Venture accounting records, asset register and cash call reconciliations, which will be integrated into MEC’s accounting records as appropriate.

Record and reconcile intercompany and related-party transactions and support transfer pricing documentation and Group reporting requirements in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller

Prepare VAT, Withholding Tax, Zakat, Corporate Income Tax, and e-invoicing data and returns, and support ZATCA compliance in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller and tax advisors

Prepare audit schedules and supporting documents, respond to audit queries in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller, and maintain complete, organised, and audit-ready financial records

Comply with finance policies, internal controls, and the authority matrix; monitor relevant accounting and tax developments; and report errors, differences, control gaps, or financial risks to the Finance Manager/Financial Controller
Assist on the internal management reporting and the external reporting to different stakeholders.

Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including invoices, reconciliations, collections, advances, and commitments, and prepare bank payments in coordination with the Finance Manager/Financial Controller for review and approval under the authority matrix
Support the Finance Manager/Financial Controller in preparing budgets, forecasts, cash flow reports, variance analysis, and other financial information required by management
Record and reconcile payroll, employee benefits, GOSI, leave provisions, and end-of-service benefits in coordination with HR and the Finance Manager/Financial Controller
Perform other accounting or finance duties assigned by the Finance Manager/Financial Controller or VP Finance and Corporate Services as assigned from time to time.

d: Marriage Reset is an online coaching company. We help married men repair their marriages, and we have grown quickly on the back of paid advertising: Meta, Google and YouTube ads that lead to a video sales letter and a booked call with our sales team. Roughly 80% of our revenue comes through that funnel.

The paid marketing team is led by the Head of Growth and includes our direct response marketers, media buyer and video editors. They set the strategy, write the ads, manage the spend and produce the creative. We need one person to run everything underneath them, and that is this role.

You will own the weekly numbers the team works from, the project system the work moves through, the checklist every ad passes before it goes live, the landing page and email builds, and the group of video editors who turn scripts into finished ads. Done well, the Head of Growth never has to assemble a report, fix a ClickUp board or ask whether something has shipped.

This is a new seat. The team will grow, and the systems you build are the ones new joiners will work from. Nobody has held this role full-time before, so part of the job is working out how it should run.

At the moment, the reporting, quality checks, page builds and editor coordination are spread across several people who each have other priorities. Nobody has this as their whole job, so the weekly numbers arrive late, compliance gets checked at the final review rather than before it, and builds wait behind copy. We want one full-time person to take all of that and run it properly.
q: 2+ years in a marketing operations, campaign operations, or funnel-build role, ideally in an online coaching, course, or direct-response business, or an agency that serves them.
You have built and maintained a ClickUp workspace (or Asana, Monday or Notion) that other people relied on, and you are the person colleagues ask when they want to know how the system works.
You have built pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels and sequences in ActiveCampaign (or Klaviyo or HubSpot)
You notice the number that does not add up. You would rather be slightly late than send something with a mistake in it.
You do not need managing. You have owned a recurring task, such as a weekly report or a daily check, for a year or more without missing it and without being reminded.
You have coordinated freelancers or a small creative team to deadlines and kept them on schedule without being their manager.
You are an expert with Claude or similar AI tools such as GrokBot/Viktor. You use AI tools daily and have automated at least one real piece of work with them.
Native-level written English. You will be reviewing edited videos and must be able to notice spelling errors. You will be writing the procedures, checklists and reports the whole team reads.
You want to be excellent at operations, you take satisfaction in doing a repeatable thing properly, and you want a company you can stay with for several years.
r: Reporting. The weekly marketing dashboard and Monday report: spend, cost per call, opt-in rate, return on ad spend, win rate per writer, and the number of ads launched, reconciled across the ad platforms, Hyros, and the CRM. A monthly summary by funnel stage. If a number is wrong, you are the one who notices.

Systems. Our ClickUp workspace for marketing: the production pipeline, statuses, dashboards, templates, and the intake from Slack. Written procedures and naming conventions for every repeatable process. An asset library organised well enough that nobody has to search Google Drive.

Quality control. A compliance and QA checklist on every ad and email before it reaches the Head of Growth: banned words, claims, naming, landing page, tracking. A log of what launched, where, and when.

Builds. Landing page variants and new funnel pages in GoHighLevel or ClickFunnels. Email sequences and automations in ActiveCampaign. Split-test setup. You build from the copywriter's text to the Head of Growth's brief.

Video editors. Day-to-day management of the editor pool: the weekly meeting, the flow of briefs, turnaround and revision targets, onboarding, screening applicants and tracking the bonus scheme. The Senior Direct Response Marketer approves the creative; you keep it moving.

Head of Growth support. Keeping every deliverable and deadline visible and on track, and flagging anything that is going to be late before it is. Booking recording sessions, running the meeting calendar, onboarding new starters, managing tool access and subscriptions.
Automation. We use Claude, ChatGPT and similar tools every day. Anything repeatable, whether that is reporting, QA checks, drafting procedures or reconciling data, is yours to automate.
x: Full-time contractor, paid monthly in US dollars, plus an annual bonus of up to 10% against targets that are within your control.

Fully remote. You need to work core hours in a European or Dubai time zone. We are open to any location that fits those hours, but we are not hiring in the Americas for this role (We do not run a fixed nine-to-five, and we do not track hours, but this is a role the rest of the team depends on. You need to be online and reachable during the working day in a European or Dubai time zone).
Please review the job description carefully. If your experience aligns with the role and this opportunity excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Note: We appreciate the time you put into applying. Our review process takes 1–2 weeks, and we’ll reach out if you’re shortlisted. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, we won’t be progressing your application this time.
Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!
